name: lead-intelligence-system
description: Lead Intelligence System: understand, score, categorise and prioritise incoming leads

scripts.setup: npm install && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,cyan "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.start: npm run build && npm start --prefix backend
scripts.check: npm run typecheck --prefix backend && npm test --prefix backend && npm run lint --prefix frontend && npm run build --prefix frontend
